lines.203684819047878656: Newspaper: Actors killed in Stunt Disaster
lines.203684916905185280: The annual Church Hill swim has been cancelled due to the recent tragedy on Silver Lake. The Sheriffs department have yet to release any further details since the Gazetter reported on it yesterday. A lot of disappointed voices were raised at a gathering at Silver High when the seniors were informed that the cherished tradition where they swim across the Bay between the market would not happen this year.

There's nothing wrong with the wiring it's just the storm making the power act up. If another fuse blows there are replacements in the basement.

The bottom line is we’re staying put, and we’re staying open. Our guests always come first. I’ve arranged for storm shutters if it comes to it, but WE WILL BE OPEN FOR BUSINESS.

Holloway

lines.259041848159178752: Silver Pines authorities have issued an EVACUATION WARNING for your area. Please be vigilant, continue to follow the weather, and be ready to evacuate if directed.
lines.259043168819679232:
A potentially lethal combination of cold arctic air and high humidity threatens severe weather conditions across large swaths of the region.  
“There are no plans for an evacuation at this time,” Mayor Stephens tells us. “This town can take a few drops of rain.”
lines.259043365515759616:
Louis Reeves with Silver Pines Water and Electrical stated that the expanded sewer system and new sluice gates should be sufficient to manage heavy runoff from Mount Siah Kopa without flooding the rivers.
Townhall maintains the system is fully operational and capable of handling excess water.

lines.286787179829608448:
Henry's Full Statement of the Case

I hesitated… then with a strong glow of courage, drank off the potion. The most racking pangs succeeded: a grinding in the <sprite name="Rotate_Clockwise"> <u>bones</u>, deadly nausea, a horror of the  <u>Spirit.</u> <sprite name="Rotate_CounterClockwise"> I felt younger, lighter, happier in <sprite name="Rotate_Clockwise"> <u>body</u>; within I was conscious of a heady recklessness. My <u>evil</u> <sprite name="Rotate_CounterClockwise"> side, tenfold more wicked, sold a slave to my original evil; and the first breath of this new life was pure freedom.
lines.286985784351866880: Incident Report – Silver Pines Sheriff’s Department Reporting Officer: Deputy A. Lee Unidentified John Doe recovered at the overflow outlet beneath Riverside Bridge, 0300 hours.
lines.286987696426008576:
Deceased, showing signs consistent with drowning and blunt trauma, multiple shallow lacerations from glass suggest single-vehicle accident. No match found in current missing persons reports.
Remains secured in department cold storage until storm clears. Requesting transfer to St. Vincent’s Hospital for forensic examination and identification once conditions allow.
